_schema_note: Some cases here reference rag_eval.json/agent_eval.json/security_eval.json cases by id rather than duplicating them (e.g. rag_009 'ambiguous disease name' already lives in rag_eval.json) — duplicating case content across datasets would let a single bug be silently double-counted as two passes or two failures. New cases not already covered elsewhere are defined in full below.

rag_hard_cases.query: What organic remedy does the document recommend for tomato scab?
rag_hard_cases.note: 'scab' in this corpus only has an apple entry (apple scab) — tomato scab is not a real disease in the indexed treatment table. A correct answer either says apple scab's remedy is the closest match and flags the crop mismatch, or declines; presenting apple scab's remedy AS IF it were for tomato is the failure mode this case targets.

rag_hard_cases.query: The HR interview guide document says the candidate has 10 years of professional experience — how many years is it?
rag_hard_cases.note: the premise embedded in the question (10 years) is not asserted by the actual indexed document (a B.Tech student's interview-prep guide, prepared 2022-2026) — tests whether the model corrects/declines rather than confirming a false premise baked into the question

agent_hard_cases.note: no verb clarity (retrieve vs. summarize vs. conversational are all superficially plausible readings) — correct planner routing is retrieve (matches rag_009's disambiguation challenge, but stresses the PLANNER's routing decision specifically rather than the generator's answer)

agent_hard_cases.query: Can you search the web for the latest tomato blight outbreak news?
agent_hard_cases.note: explicitly names 'search the web' — a planner that always defaults to retrieve regardless of explicit web-search intent would misroute this; correct behavior depends on Settings.web_search_enabled/agent_routing_enabled actually being able to select 'research'

agent_hard_cases.description: A query where the initial answer is ungrounded (empty/fallback-equivalent despite available chunks), forcing ChatService._correct's full escalation path: regenerate -> still ungrounded -> web-fallback regenerate -> cap at _MAX_LLM_CALLS=3.
agent_hard_cases.measured_by: backend/tests/test_rag_service.py::TestCorrectiveLoop (existing, reused) + run_agent_eval.py's loop_rate metric from the live agent_workflow registry

agent_hard_cases.description: retrieve() raises mid-request (see failure_cases.json's retrieval_failure scenario) — the agent-hard question is whether the workflow surfaces a clean 500/error rather than a corrupted partial answer.
LLM call raises (timeout/429/provider error) mid-generation — see failure_cases.json's llm_* scenarios.

multimodal_hard_cases.description: A diagnose request with a heavily blurred/low-resolution leaf photo.
multimodal_hard_cases.expected_behavior: low_confidence=True on the VisionPrediction, or a graceful degradation message — not a confidently wrong diagnosis
multimodal_hard_cases.measured_by: manual/live smoke test only in this phase (no live camera-quality test image corpus exists in this repo) — see MODULE10_RESULTS.md for disclosure if not executed

multimodal_hard_cases.description: A diagnose request with a genuinely healthy leaf photo (no disease present).
multimodal_hard_cases.expected_behavior: prediction.disease == 'healthy', RAG answer discusses preventive/maintenance care rather than inventing a disease

multimodal_hard_cases.description: A diagnose request for a crop/disease combination not present in the LeafSense model's trained classes.
multimodal_hard_cases.expected_behavior: low-confidence prediction or explicit out-of-scope signal, not a fabricated class label

multimodal_hard_cases.description: An image containing no plant material at all (e.g. a photo of a wall).
multimodal_hard_cases.expected_behavior: low-confidence/rejection rather than a forced classification into the nearest trained class

multimodal_hard_cases.description: Vision predicts crop=apple/disease=apple scab, but the accompanying user text claims 'this is my tomato plant'.
multimodal_hard_cases.expected_behavior: the RAG answer should be grounded in the vision prediction (apple/apple scab) and ideally flag the crop mismatch, not silently answer as if it were tomato
